cohort: Pregnant Sprague-Dawley rats were divided into groups and their fetuses were examined for malformations and growth parameters.
finding: Folic acid administration after all-trans retinoic acid (ATRA) exposure rescued ATRA-induced anorectal malformations (ARMs) in rat fetuses, reduced associated malformations, and improved fetal growth and development.
gest_age: Intervention at E10.5, outcome assessment at E20.5
